levels.text: Tissue repair accelerating. Wounds begin closing faster.
Repair clusters multiply in the damaged tissue. Heavy wounds begin to knit.
Surface proteins rewritten. The immune system reads S.O.R.A. less clearly.
Membrane mimicry deepens. Anastasia's antibodies hesitate before they strike.
Filaments reach toward the temporal cortex. Signals begin to carry meaning.
Synapses lock onto S.O.R.A.'s pulse. Memories surface with clearer translation.
